name: record-constraint-table-test-5308103ca6/record-constraint-table-test-5308103ca6-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: positive supported-expression list includes List constructor and Mapping constructor, but does not include table constructors.
## Expressions — Mapping constructor: ‘Currently spread-field not supported’.
## Statements — Foreach: ‘Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and iterable objects’.
## Import declarations: ‘Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported’; ballerina/lang.table is absent.
### Other invocation restrictions: ‘Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:’ (table:add, table:put and table:length are absent).
reason: The case essentially exercises table constructors, keyed and keyless table access, inference, mutation, equality and serialization. Table constructors are not covered by the supported expression list, and table add/put/length operations are excluded by the langlib allowlists. It also explicitly asserts mapping spread inference and table iteration, which exceed stated restrictions. Supported value:toString does not bring those table construction and mutation behaviors into scope.
unsupported_constructs: Table constructor expressions including key specifiers
Table langlib add, put and length calls
Mapping spread fields such as {...spreadField3} and {...m}
test_design_notes: The unsupported constructs occur in functions invoked by main and contribute to asserted behavior; io:println is only output instrumentation.
